name: Peter Malloy
role: Proprietor of the Western House, Little Missouri; died December 1884
bio: Peter Malloy kept the Western House hotel at Little Missouri, hosting dances there in 1884, and that May went to St. Paul to buy about a thousand cattle for a brother-in-law going into the stock business. He fell sick on a hunting trip down the river and died in December 1884, after which Mrs. Malloy kept the Western House running.
